# Maternity birthing rooms

!!! info "Definition"
    A maternity birthing room is a specialised hospital room where patients receive care and support during labour, childbirth, and the immediate postnatal period.

## Activity classification

Spells with a birth event are grouped into normal delivery, assisted delivery and non-elective C-section activity. Elective C-sections generate no time in a birth room.

A maternity spell may include time before delivery, time in a birth room or theatre, and time in a postnatal ward. This calculation represents birth-room time.

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

For each birth subgroup, convert birth spells into birth-room bed-days using the assumed time spent in a birth room.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Birth-room bed-days}
    =
    \text{Birth spells}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Birth-room length of stay (minutes)}}{1{,}440}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Divide total birth-room bed-days by the service's annual operating days and the assumed occupancy rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Required birthing rooms}
    =
    \frac{\text{Birth-room bed-days}}
    {\text{Annual operational days} \times \text{Occupancy rate}}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normal delivery | Length of stay | Pathway |
| All groups | Occupancy rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational days | Operational |
| Assisted delivery | Length of stay | Pathway |
| Non-elective C-section | Length of stay | Pathway |

## Notes

* Labour-delivery-recovery (LDR) and labour-delivery-recovery-postpartum (LDRP) service models may change how time is allocated between birth rooms and maternity ward beds.
* Birth spells also generate maternity ward-bed requirements.
* C-section procedures are modelled under obstetric theatres.

??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `NORMAL_DELIVERY_MATERNITY_BIRTH_ROOMS`
    * `ASSISTED_DELIVERY_MATERNITY_BIRTH_ROOMS`
    * `NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION_MATERNITY_BIRTH_ROOMS`

    **Conversion archetype:** bed occupancy · `FRM_BED_OCCUPANCY`

    **Operational constraint:** continuous occupancy over 24-hour operational periods

    **Workload object:** `bed_days`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | Normal delivery | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_NORMAL`) |
    | Assisted delivery | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_ASSISTED`) |
    | Non-elective C-section | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION`) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_MATERNITY` | Maternity admissions | (admimeth starts with 3 OR tretspef IN (501, 560)) AND sex = "2" AND age BETWEEN 13 AND 55 |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_NORMAL` | R24 normal delivery | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_ASSISTED` | R19 breech extraction or R20 other breech or R21 forceps cephalic or R22 vacuum or R23 cephalic vaginal w. abnormal present. head | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION` | R18 other caesarean | Not documented |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_MATERNITY`: See the Demand Model definition of maternity activity: https://connect.strategyunitwm.nhs.uk/nhp/project_information/data_extraction/inpatients.html#group

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | Normal delivery | `MATERNITY_NORMAL_DELIVERY_BIRTH_ROOM_LOS` |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_BIRTH_ROOM_OCC` |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_BIRTH_ROOM_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_DAYS` |
    | Assisted delivery | `MATERNITY_ASSISTED_DELIVERY_BIRTH_ROOM_LOS` |
    | Non-elective C-section | `MATERNITY_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION_BIRTH_ROOM_LOS` |
